claims: The 2026 FIBA World Cup Qualifying Tournament took place in San Juan, Puerto Rico.
The USA Women's National Team finished the 2026 FIBA World Cup Qualifying Tournament with a 5-0 record in March 2026.
The USA Women's National Team featured Caitlin Clark.
The FIBA website notes that the USA Women's National Team finished at the top of their group in the qualifiers.
On March 11, 2026, the USA Women's National Team defeated Senegal 110-46.
On March 12, 2026, the USA Women's National Team defeated Puerto Rico 91-48.
On March 14, 2026, the USA Women's National Team defeated Italy 93-59.
On March 15, 2026, the USA Women's National Team defeated New Zealand 101-46.
On March 17, 2026, the USA Women's National Team defeated Spain 84-70.
